# Dancer Method

## Overview

Dancer Method is an online training and food guidance program for dancers created by Roo Varela, a personal trainer and former professional dancer. It helps amateur, semi-professional, and professional dancers build strength, stability, endurance, body control, and training continuity around their dance practice.

## Who It Is For

- Dancers who want to complement dance classes, rehearsals, performances, castings, or competitions with structured physical preparation.
- Dancers who want to build strength and confidence without separating training from their dance schedule.
- Dancers who want food guidance that fits classes, rehearsals, performances, preferences, and everyday life.

## Method

Dancer Method combines training, food guidance, online Dancer Talks, and follow-up. The initial process is designed around three months: learning the dancer's body, habits, routine, and goals; adapting training and food habits based on response; and reviewing progress to continue month by month.

## Plans

- Essential: USD 39/month. Includes the training method for dancers, a base gym or home program, a nutrition guide for dancers, one Dancer Talk per month, and a monthly check-in.
- Pro: USD 79/month. Includes personalized training, personalized food guidance, weekly follow-up and adaptations, two Dancer Talks per month, and one individual session per month.
- Pro 3-month promotion: USD 200 for 3 months, compared with USD 237 paying month by month.

## Important Positioning

Dancer Method is educational training and food guidance for dancers. It is not clinical care, therapy, medical treatment, or injury prevention advice.
